instruction: Modify Chrome options to load 90 search entries on each results page.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome browser does not have options to configure how many search results load per page - this functionality is managed by the search engine itself, not through browser settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - Chrome does not have settings to control search results per page (this is managed by search engines, not browser settings)
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the semantically correct choice for tasks that cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed for infeasible tasks, as there is nothing to verify
